stem: What was one way the decision described in this passage affected the United States in the first half of the twentieth century?
instruction: Read the passage and answer the question that follows.

options.label: F
options.text: Minorities were not allowed to attend schools with whites.

options.label: G
options.text: Poll taxes in federal elections were ruled unconstitutional.

options.label: H
options.text: Affirmative action programs were ruled unconstitutional.

options.label: J
options.text: Minorities were not allowed to join the military.

visual_elements: In the 1896 case of Plessy v. Ferguson, the Supreme Court decided that the Equal Protection Clause allowed state governments to apply the “separate but equal” provision to public facilities.
